name: YMCA of Greater Hartford Camps
description_short: The YMCA of Greater Hartford runs overnight camps at Camp Jewell (Colebrook) and Camp Woodstock (Woodstock Valley), plus day camps in several Connecticut towns. Day camp is for ages 5-12, overnight camp is usually for ages 7-16, and there are teen leadership and specialty programs.

warnings: This is the YMCA of Greater Hartford's overview page for all its camps, not the page for one camp. It covers two overnight camps (Camp Jewell, Camp Woodstock), day camps in several towns, and specialty, family and teen programs. Each camp should get its own listing from its own page.
No season year, dates, prices or sessions appear on this page. It does not show whether the 2027 season has been announced.
The page says day camps run in '10 other towns' but names only 8: East Hartford, Ellington, Glastonbury, Granby, Hartford, Plainville, Putnam and Wethersfield.
camp_type is left blank because the page covers day, overnight and specialty camps together.
age_max is left blank. Day camp goes to 12, overnight usually to 16, and teen/CIT programs run 'all the way through high school'.
The page mentions Camp Chase only for family programs. It gives no location for it.
